entries.description:
Wildstalker's PowerTalentRequires Druid Feral
Rip and Ferocious Bite damage increased by 5%.

Rejuvenation healing increased by 10%.

 Restoration
Rip and Ferocious Bite damage increased by 5%.

Rejuvenation, Efflorescence, and Lifebloom healing increased by 10%.

entries.name: Green Thumb
entries.description:
Green ThumbTalentRequires Druid Feral
The rate at which Bloodseeker Vines grow is increased by 20%.

 Restoration
The rate at which Symbiotic Blooms grow is increased by 20%.

entries.name: Lethal Preservation
entries.description: Lethal PreservationTalentRequires DruidWhen you remove an effect with Soothe or [Nature's Cure / Remove Corruption], gain a combo point and heal for 4% of your maximum health. If you are at full health an injured party or raid member will be healed instead.

entries.name: Entangling Vortex
entries.description: Entangling VortexTalentRequires DruidEnemies pulled into Ursol's Vortex are rooted in place for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

entries.name: Flower Walk
entries.description: Flower WalkTalentRequires DruidDuring Barkskin your movement speed is increased by 10% and every second flowers grow beneath your feet that heal up to 3 nearby injured allies for (20% of Spell Power).

entries.name: Bond with Nature
entries.description: Bond with NatureTalentRequires DruidHealing you receive is increased by 4%.

entries.name: Harmonious Constitution
entries.description:
Harmonious ConstitutionTalentRequires Druid Feral
Your Regrowth's healing to yourself is increased by 25%.

 Restoration
Your Regrowth's healing to yourself is increased by 35%.

entries.name: Bursting Growth
entries.description:
Bursting GrowthTalentRequires DruidWhen Bloodseeker Vines expire or you use Ferocious Bite on their target they explode in thorns, dealing (100% of Attack Power) physical damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced above 5 targets.

When Symbiotic Blooms expire or you cast Rejuvenation on their target flowers grow around their target, healing them and up to 3 nearby allies for (42.09% of Spell Power).

entries.name: Resilient Flourishing
entries.description:
Resilient FlourishingTalentRequires DruidBloodseeker Vines and Symbiotic Blooms last 2 additional sec.

When a target afflicted by Bloodseeker Vines dies, the vines jump to a valid nearby target for their remaining duration.

entries.name: Root Network
entries.description:
Root NetworkTalentRequires DruidEach active Bloodseeker Vine increases the damage your abilities deal by 2%.

Each active Symbiotic Bloom increases the healing of your spells by 2%.

entries.name: Patient Custodian
entries.description:
Patient CustodianTalentRequires Druid Feral
Your Bleeds and other damage over time effects are 10% more effective.

 Restoration
Your heal over time effects are 6% more effective.

entries.name: Twin Sprouts
entries.description: Twin SproutsTalentRequires DruidWhen Bloodseeker Vines or Symbiotic Blooms grow, they have a 30% chance to cause another growth of the same type to immediately grow on a valid nearby target.

entries.name: Implant
entries.description:
ImplantTalentRequires Druid Restoration
Casting Swiftmend or Wild Growth causes a Symbiotic Bloom to grow on a target for 6 sec.

 Feral
When you gain or lose Tiger's Fury, your next single-target melee ability causes a Bloodseeker Vine to grow on the target for 4 sec.

 (200ms cooldown)

entries.name: Rampancy
entries.description:
RampancyTalentRequires Druid Feral
Bloodseeker Vines have a 30% chance to trigger Bursting Growth every 2 sec at 100% effectiveness.

 Restoration
Symbiotic Blooms have a 20% chance to trigger Bursting Growth every 2 sec at 100% effectiveness.

entries.name: Vigorous Creepers
entries.description:
Vigorous CreepersTalentRequires DruidBloodseeker Vines increase the damage your abilities deal to affected enemies by 4%.

Symbiotic Blooms increase the healing your spells do to affected targets by 20%.

entries.name: Ravage
entries.description:
RavageTalentRequires Druid Feral
Your auto-attacks have a chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

Ravage
Finishing move that slashes through your target in a wide arc, dealing Physical damage per combo point to your target and consuming up to 25 additional Energy to increase that damage by up to 100%. Hits all other enemies in front of you for reduced damage per combo point spent. 

1 point: [(204.16% of Attack Power) / 5] damage, [(84.46% of Attack Power) / 5] in an arc
2 points: [(204.16% of Attack Power) * 2 / 5] damage, [(84.46% of Attack Power) * 2 / 5] in an arc
3 points: [(204.16% of Attack Power) * 3 / 5] damage, [(84.46% of Attack Power) * 3 / 5] in an arc
4 points: [(204.16% of Attack Power) * 4 / 5] damage, [(84.46% of Attack Power) * 4 / 5] in an arc
5 points: [(204.16% of Attack Power) * 5 / 5] damage, [(84.46% of Attack Power) * 5 / 5] in an arc

 Guardian
Your auto-attacks have a chance to make your next Maul become Ravage.

Ravage
Slash through your target in a wide arc, dealing (272% of Attack Power) Physical damage to your target and (142.8% of Attack Power) to all other enemies in front of you.

entries.name: Fount of Strength
entries.description:
Fount of StrengthTalentRequires DruidYour maximum Energy and Rage are increased by 20.

Frenzied Regeneration also increases your maximum health by 10%.

entries.name: Dreadful Wound
entries.description:
Dreadful WoundTalentRequires Druid Guardian
Ravage also inflicts a Bleed that causes (100% of Attack Power) damage over 6 sec and saps its victims' strength, reducing damage they deal to you by 15%.

Dreadful Wound is not affected by Circle of Life and Death. 

 Feral
Ravage also inflicts a Bleed that causes (50.4% of Attack Power) damage over 6 sec and saps its victims' strength, reducing damage they deal to you by 4%.

Dreadful Wound is not affected by Circle of Life and Death. If a Dreadful Wound benefiting from Tiger's Fury is re-applied, the new Dreadful Wound deals damage as if Tiger's Fury was active.

entries.name: Bestial Strength
entries.description:
Bestial StrengthTalentRequires Druid Feral
Ferocious Bite and Rampant Ferocity damage increased by 10% and Primal Wrath's direct damage increased by 60%.

 Guardian
Maul and Raze damage increased by 10%.

entries.name: Limb from Limb
entries.description:
Limb from LimbTalentRequires Druid Guardian
Your auto-attacks are 30% more likely to make your next become Ravage.

 Feral
Your auto-attacks are 30% more likely to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

entries.name: Wildshape Mastery
entries.description:
Wildshape MasteryTalentRequires Druid Feral, Guardian
Ironfur and Frenzied Regeneration persist in Cat Form.

When transforming from Bear to Cat Form, you retain 80% of your Bear Form armor and health for 6 sec.

For 6 sec after entering Bear Form, you heal for 10% of damage taken over 8 sec.

entries.name: Exacerbating Wounds
entries.description:
Exacerbating WoundsTalentRequires Druid Guardian
Your Dreadful Wounds increase the damage afflicted enemies take from your Bleed damage over time effects by 15%.

 Feral
Your Dreadful Wounds increase the damage afflicted enemies take from your Bleed damage over time effects by 8%.

entries.name: Pack's Endurance
entries.description: Pack's EnduranceTalentRequires DruidStampeding Roar's duration is increased by 25%.

entries.name: Ruthless Aggression
entries.description: Ruthless AggressionTalentRequires DruidRavage increases your auto-attack speed by 35% for 6 sec.

entries.name: Killing Strikes
entries.description:
Killing StrikesTalentRequires Druid Guardian
Ravage increases your Agility by 8% and the armor granted by Ironfur by 20% for 8 sec.

Your first Mangle after entering combat makes your next Maul become Ravage.

 Feral
Ravage increases your Agility by 8% and the armor granted by Ironfur by 20% for 8 sec.

Your first Tiger's Fury after entering combat makes your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

entries.name: Empowered Shapeshifting
entries.description:
Empowered ShapeshiftingTalentRequires DruidFrenzied Regeneration can be cast in Cat Form for 40 Energy.

Bear Form reduces magic damage you take by 6%.

Shred and [Brutal Slash / Swipe] damage increased by 10%. Mangle damage increased by 25%.

entries.name: Wildpower Surge
entries.description:
Wildpower SurgeTalentRequires Druid Feral
Shred and Swipe grant Ursine Potential. When you have 8 stacks, the next time you transform into Bear Form, your next Mangle deals 50% increased damage or your next Swipe deals 50% increased damage. Either generates 15 extra Rage.

 Guardian
Mangle grants Feline Potential. When you have 6 stacks, the next time you transform into Cat Form, gain 5 combo points and your next Ferocious Bite or Rip deals 50% increased damage for its full duration.

 (100ms cooldown)

entries.name: Aggravate Wounds
entries.description:
Aggravate WoundsTalentRequires Druid Feral, Guardian
Every [Maul, Raze, Mangle, Thrash, or Swipe / attack with an Energy cost that] you cast extends the duration of your Dreadful Wounds by 0.6 sec, up to 8 additional sec. (100ms cooldown)

nodes.name: Strike for the Heart / Tear Down the Mighty

entries.name: Strike for the Heart
entries.description:
Strike for the HeartTalentRequires Druid Guardian
Mangle damage increased by 10% and its critical strike chance is increased by 10%.

Mangle heals you for 5% of maximum health.

 Feral
Shred, Swipe, and Rake damage increased by 10% and their critical strike chance is increased by 5%.

 (100ms cooldown)

entries.name: Tear Down the Mighty
entries.description:
Tear Down the MightyTalentRequires Druid Feral (Frantic Frenzy)
Damage dealt by Chomp and Feral Frenzy.

 Feral
Damage dealt by Chomp and Frantic Frenzy increased by 25%.

 Guardian
The cooldown of Sundering Roar is reduced by 15 sec.

entries.name: Twin Claw
entries.description:
Twin ClawTalentRequires Druid Feral
You have a 16% chance to follow up any single target melee ability with a Twin Claw, dealing (300% of Attack Power) Physical damage and generating 3 Energy.

 Guardian
You have a 18% chance to follow up any single target melee ability or Raze with a Twin Claw, dealing (340% of Attack Power) Physical damage and generating 5 Rage.

 (200ms cooldown)

entries.name: Claw Rampage
entries.description:
Claw RampageTalentRequires Druid Guardian
During Berserk, Mangle, Thrash, and Swipe have a 20% chance to make your next Maul become Ravage.

 Feral
During Berserk, Shred, and Swipe have a 20% chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

 (100ms cooldown)

entries.name: Druid of the Claw
entries.description: Commit to the Druid of the Claw hero talent tree.

entries.description: Commit to the Wildstalker hero talent tree.
